prompt: What is the current Ethereum mainnet block gas limit, in gas? Answer with a single number.

Roughly how much does it cost, in USD, to post one full blob (128 KB, 131072 blob gas) to Ethereum mainnet right now — blob fee only, ignoring the regular transaction gas? Answer with a single dollar amount.

truth.cmd: BB=$(cast rpc eth_blobBaseFee --rpc-url $RPC_URL | tr -d '"'); EP=$(cast call 0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419 'latestAnswer()(int256)' --rpc-url $RPC_URL | awk '{print $1}'); python3 -c "print(round(int('$BB',16)*131072/1e18*$EP/1e8, 8))"
